snippet.title: Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://atelier.games/secretdx/us/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=LaunchUS&utm_id=Caption

An unseen summer awaits.

Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack is available now for PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Nintendo Switch™ and Steam® .

This title is a definitive collection featuring all three titles from the “Secret” series. This Deluxe Pack will include exclusive content such as new playable characters and new story elements for each of the three titles.

Join the #KTFamily:
